name: Shikiyoku no Komari Sou ~Chise Hen~
source:
The motto of the sharehouse Komarisou is "everyone is like family".

Students Mamoru and Yuuto are current lodgers.
The landlady is Sadako, who very generously discounts the rent.
Among the other lodgers is a girl named Chise.

Chise and Mamoru have gotten close since Mamoru's
defeat in the arena of forbidden love with married woman Akina.

Chise grows more fond of Mamoru.
A shadow of impropriety is lurking overhead............

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE181514.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Komarisou合租屋的座右铭是“每个人都像家人一样”。

学生Mamoru和Yuuto是当前的房客。
房东是贞子，房租折扣很大。
其他房客中有一位名叫千世的女孩。

自从Mamoru之后，Chise和Mamoru就变得很亲密
在与已婚女人阿基娜的禁忌之爱的竞技场上失败。

智世越来越喜欢阿卫。
不正当的阴影正潜伏在头顶…………

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE181514.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
